notes.title: Isomorph Coming September 2nd, 2016
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Isomorph is almost complete. It will be coming out on Friday, September 2nd.

You can view the store page here:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/516870

The game trailer is here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sjRYy5_0QBQ

Thanks for your support.
